item.text: {"explanation":"Each encode event independently maps its value to a canonical JSON serialization. Objects are recursively key-sorted; arrays retain order; scalars preserve their JSON types and values. State is unchanged and irrelevant.","mapping":"input event.value -> output.key via canonical JSON serialization; prior state does not affect the mapping.","assumptions":"Inputs satisfy the stated JSON, depth, numeric, key, and event constraints. The host executes JavaScript and accepts a synchronous solve function.","applies":"function applies(input){return !!input&&Array.isArray(input.events)&&input.events.length>=0}","holds":"function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;function q(v){if(v===null)return'null';if(typeof v==='string')return'\"'+v.replace(/[\\\\\"\\u0000-\\u001f]/g,function(c){return({'\\\\':'\\\\\\\\','\"':'\\\\\"','\\b':'\\\\b','\\f':'\\\\f','\\n':'\\\\n','\\r':'\\\\r','\\t':'\\\\t'})[c]||'\\\\u'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4,'0')})+'\"';if(typeof v==='number'||typeof v==='boolean')return String(v);if(Array.isArray(v))return'['+v.map(q)+']';return'{'+Object.keys(v).sort().map(function(k){return q(k)+':'+q(v[k])}).join(',')+'}'}for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++)if(!input.events[i]||input.events[i].type!=='encode'||!output[i]||output[i].key!==q(input.events[i].value))return false;return true}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){function s(v){if(v===null)return\"null\";var t=typeof v;if(t===\"string\")return'\"'+v.replace(/[\\\\\"\\u0000-\\u001f]/g,function(c){if(c==='\\\\')return'\\\\\\\\';if(c==='\"')return'\\\\\"';if(c==='\\b')return'\\\\b';if(c==='\\f')return'\\\\f';if(c==='\\n')return'\\\\n';if(c==='\\r')return'\\\\r';if(c==='\\t')return'\\\\t';return'\\\\u'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4,'0')})+'\"';if(t==='number'||t==='boolean')return String(v);if(Array.isArray(v))return'['+v.map(s).join(',')+']';var k=Object.keys(v).sort();return'{'+k.map(function(x){return s(x)+':'+s(v[x])}).join(',')+'}'}return{state:null,output:{key:s(event.value)}}}"}
